text: {"features":[{"name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"How clearly the letter explains why this exact Information Security Engineering role is the candidate's desired next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses generic interest in software or security work with little connection to this role's specific responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names one appealing aspect of the role, but the rationale remains broad, aspirational, or only lightly tailored."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Links the candidate's background or goals to one or two responsibilities of the role in a credible way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a clear, well-reasoned case for why this specific job fits the candidate's trajectory and strengths."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a compelling, memorable reason for pursuing this exact role, tightly weaving past experience, current interests, and the team's mission."}]},{"name":"Platform security mindset","description":"How strongly the letter shows interest in building central infrastructure or tooling whose improvements compound across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss foundational infrastructure, central tooling, or organization-wide leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals a general desire for impact or scale without connecting it to platform or security-tooling work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly values foundational or central tooling, but mostly as a general preference rather than a developed orientation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames prior work or desired impact in terms of infrastructure that scales security across teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents platform leverage as a core professional orientation and ties multiple examples to broad, organization-level security impact."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security work as helping developers adopt safe defaults rather than merely policing them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not address supporting developer teams, reducing friction, or making secure behavior easier."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at helping engineers, but without a clear philosophy or concrete connection to security workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a clear belief in making the secure path easier for developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects that belief to prior work that reduced toil, manual burden, or friction for other engineers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes developer enablement a central design principle, with concrete examples of building systems that teams can adopt or rely on easily."}]},{"name":"Maintenance mindset","description":"How much the letter values testing, maintenance, hardening, and learning from failures as part of engineering identity.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses only on building or launching software, with no sign of maintenance or failure-oriented thinking."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Lists testing or maintenance as resume facts but gives no lesson, philosophy, or value attached to that work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some respect for reliability, upkeep, or the realities of operating production systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly presents maintenance or hardening work as important preparation for security engineering."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes failure analysis, stewardship, and system hardening a central, well-articulated part of the candidate's professional identity."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concretely the letter backs claims with specific examples, systems, and results.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly makes unsupported assertions about skills or fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few concrete nouns or claims, but little action, scope, or observable result."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one specific example of work or accomplishment with clear context."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses several concrete examples that show actions taken and the effect on a team or system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly uses detailed, credible examples with clear outcomes or impact, making the letter's claims easy to trust."}]},{"name":"Production software track record","description":"The strength of the letter's evidence of testing, maintaining, and launching production software over time.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes production experience at the low end of expected scope, with limited breadth across systems or lifecycle phases."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a few years of production work and some launches or maintenance, but the scope still feels narrow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid production experience across multiple services and at least two lifecycle phases."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial breadth across testing, maintenance, and launches, with multiple systems or clear progression in responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production experience with many shipped systems and a clear arc of increasing responsibility over time."}]},{"name":"Go back-end depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates role-relevant experience building back-end systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only in passing or without saying what was built with it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names Go as a language used, but the depth of use and level of ownership remain unclear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a regular working language for production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary language and ties it to concrete back-end or infrastructure systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep, role-matched Go ownership through designing or operating core back-end services, guardrails, or automation infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How well the letter demonstrates substantive Python experience relevant to tooling, automation, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or only names it without any usage context."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python for light scripting or generic use, but gives little evidence of depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, services, automation, or related work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python experience with concrete examples across more than one type of use."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep Python ownership, especially for production services, internal tooling, or AI-agent layers that others depend on."}]},{"name":"AI application depth","description":"How much concrete, production-minded experience with AI systems the letter shows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI experience at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in AI or mentions it vaguely without explaining what was built or shipped."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct experience building or shipping AI or LLM-based features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience plus discussion of evaluation, reliability, or guardrails."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial, role-relevant AI work with explicit awareness of failure modes and dependable deployment practices."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems depth","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates experience designing or implementing agentic tooling rather than only generic AI features.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or autonomous systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses agent language vaguely without describing architecture, boundaries, or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Claims hands-on agentic-system work with a basic description of what the agents do."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete agent architecture, such as Python agents paired with services that bound, audit, or constrain actions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of agentic tooling with clear autonomy boundaries, control mechanisms, and role-relevant workflows."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation depth","description":"How strongly the letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention vulnerability handling or only speaks about security in general terms."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation as an aspiration or vaguely references related work without specifics."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes some automation around vulnerability reports or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes building concrete triage workflows such as classification, deduplication, prioritization, or routing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of vulnerability-handling automation with clear scope and evidence that it materially reduced manual work or improved workflow."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How well the letter demonstrates actual practice performing security assessments rather than generic security interest.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of doing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest through language or credentials, but not through assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the candidate has performed reviews, threat models, or security assessments."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessment work, including findings, attack surfaces, code review, or remediation follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep assessment practice with attacker-minded review of varied systems and explicit validation that fixes closed the issues."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter shows practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention this area or gives no evidence of competence in it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Asserts strength in algorithms or data structures without any concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one credible example of using an algorithmic idea or data structure to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong, nontrivial example showing algorithmic thinking with meaningful system impact."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly or vividly demonstrates algorithmic fluency through specific designs, redesigns, or performance-critical choices."}]},{"name":"Security practice beyond work","description":"How much the letter shows sustained security learning or offensive practice outside normal job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no evidence of extracurricular security practice or formal security development."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a basic security credential or casual interest, but little active practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing engagement through regular CTF participation, structured study, or a meaningful security credential."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial extra security investment, such as serious CTF participation, top placements, or a demanding hands-on credential like OSCP."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional sustained security practice beyond work by combining rigorous external validation with repeated evidence of advanced offensive or adversarial skill-building."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates contributing to or maintaining open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention open-source work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional bug reports or minor fixes with little detail or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular upstream patches or contributions to projects used at work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful stewardship, such as recurring contributions, release work, or maintaining a project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows clear maintainership of an open-source project with responsibility for reviews, releases, or a real external user community."}]},{"name":"Project sophistication","description":"The technical ambition and completeness of personal projects described in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no personal project or only a minimal hobby reference with no technical substance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small finished project with modest technical scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a complete side project that shows end-to-end ownership but limited technical complexity."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial systems project involving distributed systems, consistency, recovery, or other hard engineering tradeoffs."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Describes a sustained, technically ambitious personal system built from first principles to wrestle with difficult infrastructure or reliability problems."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How well the letter is structured, with a clear progression from motivation to evidence to fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels disjointed, list-like, or hard to follow, with weak transitions or no clear through-line."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but includes abrupt jumps, fragments, or an underdeveloped arc."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally coherent and readable, though the flow is more functional than memorable."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is well organized, with smooth transitions and a clear build from background to role fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Has an especially strong narrative or argumentative flow that makes the case easy and compelling to follow."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"The degree of grammatical correctness, spelling accuracy, and overall editorial polish.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent or distracting errors that undermine professionalism or clarity."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has multiple noticeable errors, though the overall meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a few errors or awkward phrasings but remains acceptably professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and polished with only rare minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is virtually error-free, polished, and professional throughout."}]}]}
